text:
I don't see a direct linked case for these numbers or accounts in the archive — Marudhar Co-op Bank appears in CYB-114 and CYB-098, but that's only a weak MO-based lead, not a confirmed link, and the Sunrise Agro account statement/bank reply is missing entirely, which is a gap. I do note that Faisal's phone shares a tower with the 'Mehta' phone during the 09-Sep call at 21:15, which is consistent with a connection.

The IMEIs differ though, so I need to check the 08-28 and 09-28 timestamps and whether Faisal's phone was near Kalyan Road during the ATM withdrawal window, but the location data from 16-Sep is inconclusive — Nizampura at 10:08 then Kalyan Road at 10:57, which is where the Royal Mobile POS is located. Neha's claim about her SIM being couriered to Bhiwandi needs checking against 9067113452, though no CDR is on file for it.

On Ganesh, the OTPs from 23-Sep went to Vinod's phone, and Ganesh's hospital stay from 20-26 Sep is only supported by his own claim and a discharge summary that needs hospital verification — but since net banking is registered solely to the proprietor, I'm inclined to clear him. For Sunil, there's no call evidence linking him to Kavita's phone or the accused number, and his payment records, NCRP complaint, and lack of any tie to the accused numbers, IP, or accounts make for a reasonable (if weak) case to clear him too, pending verification of his 1930 acknowledgment.

For Neha, she rented out her account and received Rs 10,000, with the withdrawals occurring in Bhiwandi where her SIM was sent — this looks like facilitation even if her knowledge of the fraud is unclear, so I'll name her as an accused in a limited money-mule role and flag the investigating officer to assess her actual knowledge, since every suspect needs to be either accused or cleared. Before finalizing, I want to do one more check on Faisal's location on 08-28 and 09-28, plus any contact between his number and 9067113452.
Faisal's phone was on the same Nizampura tower during the 09-Sep 'Mehta' call. I'll check two more call times and whether Faisal had any contact with Neha's SIM.

The Mehta phone's movement lines up closely with the withdrawal window — it was in Nizampura until 09:59, then appeared near the Kalyan Road ATM by 10:48, right after the 10:02–10:09 withdrawals, with Faisal's phone also there at 10:57. This co-location pattern is solid enough to note.
I have enough to write up. Recording the diary entries now.

entries.text: The 'Dr. Mehta' SIM 7387004512 is on forged KYC, bought through the Royal Mobile POS on Kalyan Road, Bhiwandi. It ran in a single handset (IMEI 355412097781230) and was based on the Nizampura, Bhiwandi tower (BWD-NZM-04), where Faisal Qureshi's broadband address is. Faisal's 9820456631 was on the same tower during the Mehta calls to the victim on 28-Aug 19:30 and 09-Sep 21:15. Both phones moved to Kalyan Road on 16-Sep at about 10:48-10:57, around the time of the Neha Patil ATM withdrawals.

Vinod's 9922310045 called 7387004512 six times (03-23 Sep) and called Faisal's 9820456631 three times (25-Aug, 05-Sep, 24-Sep). On 23-Sep he called Mehta at 13:35, 25 minutes after the cash withdrawal. GDVBNK OTP SMS arrived on his phone, in his own handset, a minute before each CoinVault IMPS.
Claims he does not know Dr. Arvind Mehta or Faisal. His CDR shows 6 outgoing calls to 7387004512 and 3 to 9820456631.

He has no net-banking access (bank: proprietor is the only user). OTPs went to Vinod's phone in Osmanpura, and Vinod cashed the 23-Sep self-cheque in person. Ganesh was hospitalised 20-26 Sep; verify the discharge summary with Sahyog Hospital.

He is a fellow victim. He paid Rs 2.5L (T00109) and Rs 1.5L (T00135) into the mule account and filed his own 1930 complaint. No record links him to 7387004512, 9820456631, the admin IP or the money flows.
